content: We observe that all of our models far outperform the models presented in original papers for these common stress tests, with our two RoBERTa models performing best. Both perform well on SNLI-Hard and achieve accuracy levels in the high 80s on the `antonym' (AT), `numerical reasoning' (NR), `length' (LN), `spelling error'(SE) sub-datasets, and show marked improvement on both `negation' (NG), and `word overlap' (WO). Training a RoBERTa model also on ANLI appears to be particularly useful for the NR, WO, NG and AT NLI stress tests.
